verdict.rationale: Choosing a data-storage region is a fair question for a SaaS billing platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents region selection or data-residency controls for Stripe Billing. The items cover subscriptions, invoicing, sandboxes, API versioning and pricing, none of which address where data is stored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
